Name: Antique Well
Author: MoxxyHaven
Description:
[size=3]This is a mod that changes 'Well' to 'Antique Fountain'.[/size]
[size=3]I was thinking of adding animations, but the animation mod broke in 1.6.0...[/size]
[size=3]so I made it with just one frame.[/size]
[size=3]I'll try some animation work once the issue is resolved.[/size]
[size=3]This is my first Stardew Valley mod. I'll be making many more mods in the future.[/size]

[b]Install :[/b]
[size=3]Zip File Extract (~:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)[/size]

[b]Require Mods : [/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] [/size]
